text: No comparable period in our history has produced so many important reforms in our economic and industrial life, or changed so much the spirit and purpose of our political action. We have tried, with careful thought, to put our house in order: to correct the worst errors and abuses in industry, to free and speed up the nation's energy and talent, and to turn our politics toward the basic interests of the people as a whole. The record is varied and distinguished. But I will not review it.
